# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 83 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 83 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_083_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Chapter 6

**1** "What is the name of the Son of God?" I asked. "The name of the Son of God is great and boundless, and upholds the whole world. If then all creation is upheld by the Son of God, what do you think of those who are called by his name and bear his name and walk in his commandments? **2** Do you see what kind of people he upholds? Those who bear his name with their whole heart. He became their foundation and bears them gladly, because they are not ashamed to bear his name." **3** I said to him, "Tell me the names of the virgins, and of those women who are clothed in the black garments." **4** He said, "Listen to the names of the mightier virgins who stand at the corners: the first is Faith, the second Continence, the third Power, the fourth Patience. The others who stand between them are named: Simplicity, Guilelessness, Holiness, Joyfulness, Truth, Understanding, Harmony, Love. **5** These names are borne by those who bear the name of the Son of God and walk in his commandments." **6** "And the names of those who carry the black garments?" I asked. **7** "These also," he said, "are ten in number: Unbelief, Intemperance, Disobedience, Deceit, Sorrow, Wickedness, Licentiousness, Bitter-temperedness, Lying, Hatred. The servant of God who bears these names shall see the kingdom of God, but shall not enter it." **8** "But the stones that were cast away and did not fit into the building — who are they?" **9** "These are those who believed and were living in a holy and righteous manner, but had these evil names; these therefore were cast away from the tower and were not fit for the building of it. These hurt those who are walking in righteousness; therefore they were cast from the tower and given over to these women who carry the black garments; and they shall not enter the tower until they cast off the works of these women."

---

*EMET renders all virtue and vice names precisely. The twelve virtues (v. 4) mirror the twelve stones/tribes structure developed in Similitude 9. "Bitter-temperedness" renders pikria.*
